sources.title: Hugging Face launches Microduck, a $399 open-source robot duck
sources.snippet: Microduck is the latest step in Hugging Face's broader push to bring open-source AI into the physical world. The company launched LeRobot, a collection of AI models, datasets, and development tools for robotics, in 2024. It later released the programmable SO-101 robotic arm and, in May 2025, introduced two humanoid robots: HopeJR and Reachy Mini.

sources.title: Hugging Face Unveils Microduck: A $399 Open-Source Robot for AI ...
sources.snippet: The launch of Microduck by Hugging Face and Pollen Robotics signifies a notable step in making advanced robotics and embodied AI development more accessible. With its open-source software, diverse capabilities, and developer-focused design, Microduck provides a platform for innovation in physical AI.

sources.snippet: Microduck - A duck-like biped robot designed for physical AI experimentation and fun Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face have unveiled the Microduck, a 25 cm tall biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two motion sensors, and an articulated beak that can pick up objects.
